summary: Read a text built only from the digits 2 through 9. Digits match letters the way a phone keypad does: 2 matches abc, 3 matches def, 4 matches ghi, 5 matches jkl, 6 matches mno, 7 matches pqrs, 8 matches tuv, and 9 matches wxyz. Moving from the left of the text to the right, pick one letter for each digit and form every possible letter text. Write all of those letter texts. Any arrangement among them is acceptable.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one token of text without spaces.
